case_title: SOMASUNDARAM @ SOMU v. THE STATE REP. BY THE DEPUTY COMMISSIONER OF POLICE
weapon: Nylon rope, chain, black bag, cell phone, knife, locks
confession: A4 made a confessional statement; A16 gave a confessional statement
aggravating_circumstances: Abduction, illegal confinement, murder, cremation under fictitious name, conspiracy
trial_court_outcome: Convicted all the accused while acquitting A12 and A18
neutral_facts: The accused abducted the victim, illegally detained him, and demanded a huge sum. When the victim refused to comply, he was strangled and murdered. The body was cremated under a fictitious name. The accused used a nylon rope and chain to restrain the victim. The victim's body was found tied up in a factory, and the accused were involved in the illegal confinement and subsequent cremation. The prosecution relied on circumstantial evidence, including the recovery of a motorcycle and a black bag, and the testimony of accomplices. The accused were also involved in the planning and execution of the abduction and murder.
